title: Human In the Loop Workflow Demo

cues.en: All right, folks, the last pattern for the workflows and the agent framework is about human in the loop.
cues.zh: 各位，Agent Framework 工作流程的最後一種模式，是 Human-in-the-Loop，人類參與流程。

cues.en: When you actually are trying to run a workflow that has multiple agents involved, for instance, but at some point, you need to stop and waiting for a human to approve or reject or add any
cues.zh: 例如執行包含多個代理程式的流程時，某個階段需要停下來，等待人類核准、拒絕，或加入，

cues.en: content whatsoever that the system cannot move forward without an interaction from a human being.
cues.zh: 內容。沒有人的互動，系統就不能繼續。

cues.en: Let's see how that works in the agent framework workflows.
cues.zh: 看看 Agent Framework 如何處理。

cues.en: I created the project in here right now called human in the loop workflow demo.
cues.zh: 我已建立 HumanInTheLoopWorkflowDemo 專案。

cues.en: Let me open up this project.
cues.zh: 開啟專案。

cues.en: And again, I'm going to bring in the same exact nougat packages that we used before.
cues.zh: 同樣加入前面使用的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And that's where the workflows for the agent framework itself 1.1, the user secrets, the extensions and the Azure AI OpenAI.
cues.zh: 包括 Workflows、Agent Framework 1.1、User Secrets、Extensions 與 Azure.AI.OpenAI。

cues.en: All right, let's go ahead and save all of this.
cues.zh: 先儲存。

cues.en: And I'm going to go ahead and bring in the code and we'll try to explain it line by line.
cues.zh: 接著貼入程式碼，逐行解釋。

cues.en: I'm going to go ahead and open up program.cs, removed all that stuff from there.
cues.zh: 開啟 Program.cs，移除範本。

cues.en: Let me bring in the code and we'll start go ahead and first of all, let me explain what I'm trying to accomplish in here, folks.
cues.zh: 加入程式碼。首先說明這裡想達成什麼。

cues.en: What I'm trying to accomplish is to create a game. All right.
cues.zh: 我想建立一個遊戲。

cues.en: So the system, first of all, is going to ask me to, to guess and an animal, okay.
cues.zh: 系統首先會要求我猜一種動物。

cues.en: And I will have multiple tries, maybe I will not get it from the first time, it will give me a hint.
cues.zh: 可能要猜很多次，第一次猜不到，就提供提示。

cues.en: And then I'm going to try to answer that.
cues.zh: 接著我會再嘗試回答。

cues.en: I created an array of animals, whether it's a wolf, eagle, tiger, blah, blah, blah, shark, panda, all of these, okay.
cues.zh: 這裡建立動物陣列，包括狼、老鷹、老虎、鯊魚、熊貓等等。

cues.en: And then once I start the game, the workflow will start by asking me you, first of all, the instruction to the agent itself, you are the judge in a guessing game where it is about
cues.zh: 遊戲啟動後，工作流程會開始互動。先提供代理程式指示：你是猜謎遊戲的裁判，題目是，

cues.en: guessing animals, each hint should only give one fact, okay.
cues.zh: 猜動物，每個提示只提供一個事實。

cues.en: So I'm telling the agent exactly how it's supposed to deal with that game.
cues.zh: 因此明確告訴代理程式，應該如何進行遊戲。

cues.en: The important part in here is that I'm going to have to wait for a human in the loop answer.
cues.zh: 重要的是，需要等待人類參與者的答案。

cues.en: So you're going to have to tell me your guess, is it a wolf, is it a dolphin, is it a shark, is it a dog, and then I'll take that input and I'll keep going back into a workflow.
cues.zh: 你要告訴我猜測，是狼、海豚、鯊魚，還是狗。取得輸入後，再回到工作流程。

cues.en: So notice my workflow in here, right.
cues.zh: 注意這裡的流程。

cues.en: I have multiple edges, it will first start from the request port, being able to take the guess that you gave me, and I'm going to actually have to create an executor called
cues.zh: 有多條 Edge，先從 Request Port 開始，取得你的猜測，另外需要建立一個 Executor，叫，

cues.en: Evaluate and HintExecutor, let me see where that class is at the bottom in here.
cues.zh: EvaluateAndHintExecutor，在下面找到它。

cues.en: So there is my class called Evaluate and HintExecutor, and it descends from the executor like we've seen in other examples of patterns as well.
cues.zh: 這就是類別，和前面模式的範例一樣，繼承 Executor。

cues.en: This class in here is going to actually end up taking the agent and the animal that was guessed.
cues.zh: 它會接收代理程式，以及這輪要猜的動物。

cues.en: Let's say, for instance, that the intention is the shark, for instance, okay.
cues.zh: 例如目標是鯊魚。

cues.en: Once we get to this, and I actually have been asked what the guess is, all right, and I
cues.zh: 當取得猜測，

cues.en: actually enter this execution itself in here, this class will end up, first of all, keeping
cues.zh: 進入這個 Executor 時，類別首先會記錄，

cues.en: track of the number of tries.
cues.zh: 嘗試次數。

cues.en: I might not get it from the first time, or second time, or the third time, I need more hints.
cues.zh: 可能第一次、第二次或第三次都猜不到，需要更多提示。

cues.en: Plus, I'm going to create a list of strings that I will keep all my hints that I got before from the LLM.
cues.zh: 另外建立字串清單，保存先前從 LLM 取得的所有提示。

cues.en: The reason why I'm doing that is because I don't want the LLM to give me the same hint twice.
cues.zh: 因為不希望 LLM 重複提供相同提示。

cues.en: If the hint has been given already, I definitely do not want to be given a second time.
cues.zh: 已經給過的提示，絕對不希望再出現。

cues.en: Like all my executors that we've seen before, I have to handle the async and override the handleAsync function itself.
cues.zh: 和其他 Executor 一樣，需要覆寫 HandleAsync。

cues.en: That will take the message coming in, it will take the context of the entire workflow, and of course, it will have the cancellation token as usual.
cues.zh: 它接收輸入訊息、整個工作流程的 Context，以及一般的 CancellationToken。

cues.en: So I will increment the number of tries, all right, and in here I will have two choices as you can see.
cues.zh: 先增加嘗試次數，這裡有兩個分支。

cues.en: I guessed it correctly, or I did not guess it correctly.
cues.zh: 猜對，或猜錯。

cues.en: So if I guessed it correctly, I want the system to say, you guessed it, the answer is indeed, let's say it was a shark, and then it will say tries used, and it will tell me
cues.zh: 如果猜對，希望系統說「你猜對了，答案確實是鯊魚」，再顯示 Tries Used，告訴我，

cues.en: how many times I went through this before, first, second, third, fourth, different tries till I get the correct answer itself.
cues.zh: 總共經過第一次、第二次、第三次或第四次等幾次嘗試，才找到正確答案。

cues.en: If I did not guess it correctly, it will go into the else, and it will send to the LLM, it will say generate a hint for a child to guess the animal, which is going to be shark,
cues.zh: 如果沒猜對，就進入 else，要求 LLM：為小朋友產生一個提示，讓他猜出動物，這裡假設是鯊魚，

cues.en: and then hints already given, and I'll give you a list of all the hints given already so you don't actually have to use one of those, you have to come up with something new.
cues.zh: 再附上先前全部提示，要求不要重複，而是想出新內容。

cues.en: So make the new hint unique and do not repeat the same hint part.
cues.zh: 新的提示必須不同，不能重複。

cues.en: So that's, again, part of the continuation of the agent to be able to do that as well.
cues.zh: 這也是代理程式持續互動的一部分。

cues.en: And then I'm going to get the agent response in here, I'm going to run async on it, like we've done before with the new hint, and every time I would be waiting for the human in the
cues.zh: 接著像之前一樣呼叫 RunAsync，取得新的提示。每次都要等待 Human-in-the，

cues.en: loop to kick in, for somebody to tell me what the new guess is.
cues.zh: Loop，讓人告訴我們新的猜測。

cues.en: So I can keep guessing based on the hint I was given, and that will stop the entire flow of the workflow until the human actually guesses that animal.
cues.zh: 因此可以根據提示持續猜測，而在等待人類輸入時，整個工作流程會暫停，直到猜出動物。

cues.en: Does that make sense, folks?
cues.zh: 大家理解嗎？

cues.en: Remember the feedback to user all the way at the top in here?
cues.zh: 記得上面的 FeedbackToUser 嗎？

cues.en: See what I did, the run streaming async like we all did, and the watch streaming async?
cues.zh: 這裡和之前一樣有 RunStreamingAsync 與 WatchStreamAsync。

cues.en: Just remember the feedback to user, this is the record that contains, as you can see here at the bottom, the hint itself, and the first time we run this, the initialization
cues.zh: FeedbackToUser 是一個 record，下面可以看到，其中包含提示。第一次執行時，初始化，

cues.en: will be to false, and then it will be true after that.
cues.zh: 狀態先是 false，之後才改成 true。

cues.en: So the first time around when we give the hint, the initialization will be false, and then we will turn it to true based on the feedback to the user itself.
cues.zh: 因此第一次提供提示時，還沒初始化，接著再根據 FeedbackToUser 更新為 true。

cues.en: That's what's happening in here inside of the event coming in on the watch streaming async.
cues.zh: 這些處理發生在 WatchStreamAsync 接收的事件中。

cues.en: So you will notice I will do something like feedback to user, external request.data as feedback to user as the record that came in.
cues.zh: 這裡把 ExternalRequest.Data 轉成 FeedbackToUser，也就是收到的 record。

cues.en: I'm going to actually do the initialization, whether it's true or false.
cues.zh: 接著判斷是否為初始化階段。

cues.en: If it's true, guess what animal I'm thinking of.
cues.zh: 第一次就顯示：猜猜我正在想哪種動物。

cues.en: If it has already been initialized after the first time, it will have to tell you that it's not the animal I'm thinking of, because the only way you can get back here again after
cues.zh: 如果第一次之後已經初始化，就會告訴你，這不是我想到的動物，因為能在，

cues.en: it has been initialized is that you guessed it wrong, right?
cues.zh: 初始化之後再次回到這裡，代表剛剛猜錯了，對吧？

cues.en: So these are the two different things, whether it has been initialized or it has not been initialized yet.
cues.zh: 因此區分為尚未初始化，以及已初始化兩種情況。

cues.en: And then I'm going to say your guess, and this is where the read line, you will be able to type in the word shark or bear or something, and then it will enter again, it will continue
cues.zh: 接著顯示 Your Guess，透過 ReadLine，讓你輸入 shark、bear 等文字，再重新進入，

cues.en: descending response into the external response of the agent itself.
cues.zh: 透過 ExternalResponse 把回應送回工作流程。

cues.en: So it will keep going like this until it finds out that you actually answered correctly.
cues.zh: 如此持續，直到發現你回答正確。

cues.en: Not only that, but for kids, for instance, they might spell shark with a C instead of a K, who knows?
cues.zh: 不只這樣，小朋友可能會把 shark 的 K 拼成 C，誰知道呢？

cues.en: So I want to make sure in here, I'm going to say the input inside of the evaluator for the evaluate and hint executor, I'm going to say, is this the right answer for guessing
cues.zh: 因此在 EvaluateAndHintExecutor 的評估輸入中，要詢問，這是否是猜測，

cues.en: the animal, which is shark?
cues.zh: 鯊魚這個動物的正確答案？

cues.en: All right, allow for spelling errors of the animal as well.
cues.zh: 另外允許動物名稱有拼字錯誤。

cues.en: So it doesn't have to be exact match, because we're saying this is for children to play around with, and so on.
cues.zh: 不必完全符合字串，因為這是給小朋友玩的。

cues.en: So all of this stuff will go back and forth with the LLM, with the agent itself, waiting for an answer or a suggestion, or the name of the animal from the human in the loop as well.
cues.zh: 因此系統與 LLM、代理程式持續往返，同時等待人類參與者提供答案、建議，或猜測的動物名稱。

cues.en: Does that make sense?
cues.zh: 這樣理解嗎？

cues.en: Everybody with me?
cues.zh: 大家都跟得上嗎？

cues.en: All right, let's go ahead and see how this works.
cues.zh: 接著實際看看。

cues.en: It's probably a little bit more convoluted than the other ones.
cues.zh: 這可能比其他模式稍微複雜。

cues.en: But again, there's a lot going on in here, because we are waiting for somebody to enter something no matter what it is.
cues.zh: 因為有很多處理，而且一定要等待某個人輸入內容。

cues.en: Sometimes just an approval or a rejection of a process that you have to say yes or no.
cues.zh: 有時只是核准或拒絕某個程序，回答是或否。

cues.en: And sometimes it's like this, you have to give it a word or a sentence or something to keep going with the agents.
cues.zh: 有時則像這樣，需要提供單字或句子，代理程式才能繼續。

cues.en: All right, I'm going to save all of this.
cues.zh: 先儲存。

cues.en: And we'll come in here, we'll say .net run.
cues.zh: 到這裡，輸入 dotnet run。

cues.en: And we'll make this a little bit bigger.
cues.zh: 把畫面放大。

cues.en: And let's see, what is it going to do?
cues.zh: 看看會做什麼。

cues.en: It's going to actually start the game for me.
cues.zh: 應該會開始遊戲。

cues.en: And hopefully it will say, hey, it will give me a hint, it will tell me to guess the animal and give me the first hint.
cues.zh: 希望它先要求猜動物，並提供第一個提示。

cues.en: And based on that, hopefully I'll be able to figure it out.
cues.zh: 根據提示，希望我能猜出答案。

cues.en: We'll see how much, how old I have to be, hopefully five years old, so maybe I will get it right.
cues.zh: 看看需要幾歲才懂，希望五歲就會，那我應該猜得到。

cues.en: Guess what animal I'm thinking of?
cues.zh: 猜猜我正在想哪種動物？

cues.en: It is often kept as a household pet.
cues.zh: 它經常被當成家庭寵物。

cues.en: So this is usually a cat or a dog.
cues.zh: 所以通常是貓或狗。

cues.en: I know there is no cat in the array.
cues.zh: 我知道陣列裡沒有貓。

cues.en: So this would be a dog.
cues.zh: 因此應該是狗。

cues.en: Okay, but I don't want to answer the correctly.
cues.zh: 但我不想直接答對。

cues.en: So I'm going to do it wrong first.
cues.zh: 所以先故意猜錯。

cues.en: We'll say shark.
cues.zh: 輸入 shark，鯊魚。

cues.en: Okay, let's go ahead and say shark and we'll go for it.
cues.zh: 好了，送出鯊魚。

cues.en: That will get back into the loop again.
cues.zh: 這會再次回到迴圈。

cues.en: All right, and the workflow will go to the next step and find out that I don't have the correct answer.
cues.zh: 工作流程進入下一步，發現答案不正確。

cues.en: See, the LM is running right now.
cues.zh: 可以看到 LLM 正在執行。

cues.en: So it has to actually tell me that that was not the correct guess, but it would have to give me a second, a hint that has not been given before.
cues.zh: 因此必須告訴我猜錯，並提供第二個、沒有出現過的提示。

cues.en: Okay, so it cannot be a household pet, right?
cues.zh: 所以不能再說家庭寵物。

cues.en: It is not an animal I'm thinking of.
cues.zh: 這不是我想到的動物。

cues.en: It's not the animal, but it barks. All right.
cues.zh: 不是那種動物，但它會吠叫。

cues.en: If you don't know it by now, you really should reevaluate your life. All right. Sounds good.
cues.zh: 如果到現在還不知道，可能真的要重新思考人生了。很好。

cues.en: Anyway, this one would say dog and we push that.
cues.zh: 總之，這次輸入 dog，再送出。

cues.en: And at this point, also the LM says, okay, that was the correct answer.
cues.zh: 現在 LLM 也判斷，這是正確答案。

cues.en: It will tell me you got it in two different tries, not on the first try. Okay. You got it. You guessed it.
cues.zh: 它會告訴我，總共嘗試兩次，不是第一次就猜到。你猜對了。

cues.en: The answer is indeed a dog.
cues.zh: 答案確實是狗。

cues.en: Thrice used is two.
cues.zh: Tries Used 是二。

cues.en: And we are done with that.
cues.zh: 遊戲結束。

cues.en: Does that make sense, folks?
cues.zh: 大家理解嗎？

cues.en: I would like you to play around with this, maybe change the context, but just understand going in and out of the workflow, waiting for a human to kick in. All right.
cues.zh: 希望你實際玩玩，也許更換情境，重點是理解如何進出工作流程，等待人類介入。

cues.en: So this is the whole idea behind human in the loop workflows. All right.
cues.zh: 這就是 Human-in-the-Loop 工作流程的完整概念。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed this video.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這支影片，

cues.en: You got the concept of how to deal with that.
cues.zh: 也掌握了處理方式。

cues.en: And I'll see you again in future videos. Thank you.
cues.zh: 之後影片再見，謝謝。
